page.content:
Emperor of reconquest, the Code, and Hagia Sophia.

How Justinian I connects

  • Location: Hagia Sophia — Justinian rebuilt Hagia Sophia after the Nika riots.
  • Work: Corpus Juris Civilis — Justinian ordered the Corpus Juris Civilis.
  • Topic: Byzantine Empire — Justinian I ruled the sixth-century empire at its reconquest peak.
  • Character: Theodora — Theodora was Justinian's empress and political partner.
  • Character: Belisarius — Belisarius was Justinian's chief general.

What is Justinian I?

Justinian I (r. 527–565) tried to restore a Mediterranean Rome: the Corpus Juris Civilis, the rebuilding of Hagia Sophia, Belisarius's wars, and the Nika crisis he survived with Theodora.

Key threads lead to Hagia Sophia, Corpus Juris Civilis, Byzantine Empire, Theodora and Belisarius.
